package.name: san_comm_sim
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — Communication simulators (WiFi6 + LTE + LoRa).
Ported and adapted from skyhunter_comm (Limon code). Provides pure-Python simulators for the SAN swarm comm stack:
- wifi6_mesh_simulator: log-distance + shadow fading RF model - lte_simulator: LTE RSRP/SNR + handover modeling - lora_simulator: LoRa heartbeat + ESTOP fallback - swarm_comm_manager: 3-tier FSM (WiFi6 → LTE → LoRa) - mesh_visualizer: RViz MarkerArray link visualization - rssi_plotter: live RSSI vs distance plot - comm_traffic_filter: inter-tier traffic policy enforcement
Pure-logic models (path_loss, comm_fsm, etc.) under models/ are standalone testable.
★ Soft Kill 제외 — jammer_service.py, RF 재머 시뮬레이션, JammedLink/JammedLinks 메시지, JamLink/UnjamLink 서비스 모두 포팅되지 않음. SH_Unitree_Patrol 의 대드론 대응은 Hard Kill 전용.
Test files: 3개 잔존 (test_all, test_delay, test_packet_loss). Soft Kill 의존 테스트 7개 제외.
